name: @wealthai/astral-dom
description: The React-DOM BINDING for @wealthai/astral (docs/73 ASTRAL-321, from F153). `packages/astral` is platform-neutral source; this is its DOM host binding — the primitives adapter and the block dispatcher — living in a package rather than inside the web app, so the web chat and the AstroMatch extension side panel render ONE wheel, ONE scorecard and ONE input widget. The app-local capabilities it needs (a way to send a message, an image upload) are INJECTED through `installAstralDomHost`, never imported from `@/…` — which resolves in more than one tsconfig and would compile against the wrong module (F153, and F22 before it). This package performs NO network.
